items.Sentence: The WWTF consists of 12 septic tanks operated in parallel, each with a capacity of 7,500 gallons, and 87 seepage pits.
Wastewater gravity flows to the WWTF where it is pumped into septic tanks by a lift station.
Sludge from the septic tanks is removed periodically and disposed at the City of Madera WWTF.
The WWTF is currently regulated by WDRs Order 95-157, which allows a monthly average daily discharge flow of 86,000 gallons per day (gpd) to seepage pits.
